name: byok-models
description: Zero-touch dynamic language model provider for local inference. Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, and more. Models are discovered live from /v1/models.

byokModels.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API (should end with /v1). Models are fetched from <baseUrl>/models.

byokModels.apiKey.markdownDescription: Plaintext fallback for the API key. Prefer the command **BYOK Models: Set API Key**, which stores the key in VS Code secret storage.

byokModels.maxInputTokens.description: Reported max input tokens for discovered models.

byokModels.maxOutputTokens.description: Reported max output tokens for discovered models.

byokModels.enableTools.description: Advertise tool-calling capability (needed for Copilot agent mode) and pass tools through to the endpoint.

byokModels.injectWorkspaceContext.markdownDescription: Automatically inject workspace context (active files, git info, open tabs) into system prompts. Enables models to understand your project structure and provide more relevant responses.

byokModels.debugLogging.markdownDescription: Enable verbose logging of tool calls, results, and workspace context. Check the **BYOK Models** output channel for details.

byokModels.maxWorkspaceContextChars.markdownDescription: Maximum characters for workspace context injected into prompts. Lower this for small local models (8B and below) to avoid overwhelming them.

byokModels.requestTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Request timeout in milliseconds for chat completions. If the model does not respond within this time, the request is cancelled. Default: 120000 (2 minutes).

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL, ending with /v1.

commands.title: BYOK Models: Show Workspace Context
commands.description: Display the workspace context that will be injected into model prompts.
